open_points.subject: create_expense_from_recognition
open_points.text: the expense member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind
open_points.other_text: - AuditEntityKind enum members: BUDGET_VERSION='budget_version', EXPENSE='expense', EXPENSE_ALLOCATION='expense_allocation', EXPENSE_DOCUMENT='expense_document', PRODUCER_GRANT='producer_grant', PROGRESS_PHOTO='progress_photo', SECTION_PLAN='section_plan', SECTION_PROGRESS='section_progress', SERVICE_CREDENTIAL='service_credential', SERVICE_PRINCIPAL='service_principal', SNAPSHOT_IMPORT='snapshot_import', STAFF_ACCOUNT='staff_account', STAFF_ASSIGNMENT='staff_assignment', STAFF_SESSION='staff_session', VIEWER='viewer', VIEWER_CREDENTIAL='viewer_credential', VIEWER_GRANT='viewer_grant', WORK_PAYMENT='work_payment'
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared EXPENSE member instead of the nonexistent lowercase expense member?

open_points.subject: _classify_expense_replay
open_points.text: - _classify_expense_replay: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return ExpenseOperationOutcome containing the existing aggregate with replayed true only for equal intake_fingerprint and otherwise raise ExpenseConflictError without mutation, the replay identity being recognized_document_id with intake_fingerprint as the content check.
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen). A record listed in RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE, new or changed, comes only from its builder: call the builder, never model_copy or a constructor of it. Any other model value: derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: How can replayed be set to true when ExpenseOperationOutcome must come only from build_expense_operation_outcome, whose declared signature accepts only aggregate and no replayed value; must the builder accept replayed or must post-builder copying be allowed?

open_points.subject: _validate_initial_allocations
open_points.text: so that rejection keeps the input-rejection answer the legacy BudgetValidationError produced
open_points.rule:
- note, которая не должна создавать ребро, не называет чужой экспорт целым
      словом
open_points.question: Replace BudgetValidationError with prose that is not the whole-word name of the foreign export, because this module is required not to import its provider.

open_points.subject: decode_recognition_publication
open_points.text: - decode_recognition_publication: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST refuse with ExpenseValidationError a normalized item whose quantity, unit_price or line_total is not a finite decimal, whose quantity is not greater than zero, or whose unit_price or line_total is below zero, and MUST keep each accepted item amount exactly as supplied, without quantizing it, because item amounts are validated for shape only and are not stored.
open_points.rule:
- Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов. Значение размещается процедурой 15.2 и доходит до кода одним из трёх путей §15.3.1; note называет
  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus`, константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Move the zero comparison thresholds into imported provider constants and name those constants in the note.
